branch.description: The branch the task worked on, or null when it worked on none

head.description: The commit the worktree was at when the attempt ended

commits.description: Commits the attempt added to the branch

summary.description: The worker's final message, which is also the task's result

behind.description: Tasks cut from this task's branch, directly or through another task on it, whose own branch does not contain head; empty when none are behind
